factors.gate: none: a cost term in the annealer, acts on every board

board selection, not code: chan-gated ran only on boards passing the pinch gate in tools/kaeres/experiments/chan-gated/gate.py (mean overlapping channel-halo pairs >= 10 after the w=0 anneal). In d6-allon the term acts on every board.
in code: kae.place.margin_gate (density gate, pads/cm2/copper layer); the margin is dropped on boards under the gate
factors.note: margin-gate's gated arm also set place_margin_regions=1 (region caps, kae.place.margin_gate.caps); d6-allon's specified on-settings leave it at 0. Decide before registering whether the on arm should carry it.

factors.gate: in code: kae.place.arrays detects component matrices in the netlist; inert on boards without one
in code: kae.place.barriers finds regions split by voids or all-copper keepouts; inert on boards without a split, and falls back to whole-board placement when a region cannot legalize
